issue.title: Onboarding: James Yang
issue.body:
## What did you find?

Alignment is lower for rewritten words with both tokenizers: BERT 69% → 19%, GPT-2 62% → 31% (see `alignment.png`). The rewritten words aren't split into many more pieces; the cuts just land in the wrong place.

## Checklist

- [x] Only files under `submissions/jeojdi1/` are changed
- [x] Notebook runs top to bottom from a fresh kernel
- [x] `findings.md` and `alignment.png` are included

## One thing I'd like feedback on

The "rewritten" group picks up words that aren't spelling changes at the join (butler, beetle, Nelson). Is that worth filtering out, and how would you do it?
